about: Measured photo values (tools/photo_measure.py; docs/spec/data.md "measured.json"): c RMS contrast, sp 2-98% spread, l mean luminance, sa mean saturation, ss saturated share, wa warm share of the saturated pixels, sh Laplacian variance x1e4, pk sharpest part; px the file's long side; b the same on the fish's box; h the crop/box tag.
